title: Unit 1: LEISURE TIME
content: Many teenagers are fond of different leisure activities after a long week of schoolwork. Some students prefer spending time outdoors to stay in shape . For example, they might go snowboarding in the winter or visit a relaxing resort in the summer. On the other hand, others are keen on indoor activities like doing puzzles or making origami . If you fancy being creative, you can try DIY projects such as making a beautiful bracelet with a craft kit . However, some people detest doing physical activities because they do not want to use their muscles too much. Instead, they might just send a message to keep in touch with their friends. Whatever you choose, having a good balance between study and play is never a crazy idea.

title: Unit 2: LIFE IN THE COUNTRYSIDE
content: The villagers situate their ancient cottage near a vast , picturesque canal that seems to stretch endlessly . During the harvest , hard-working farmers cultivate the crop , plough the paddy field , and use a well-trained herd of cattle or a modern combine harvester to gather the grain . Afterwards, they load the truck and unload the dry goods near the ferry while I observe the beautiful scenery with a distant lighthouse . I never envy the unsociable city life because our generous , hospitable , and supportive neighbors always share a fascinating speciality with us . Working outside helps them get a tan as they feed the poultry , milk the cows, catch fish in the pond , and pick fruits in the orchard . In the evenings, children enjoy bamboo dancing , kite-flying , and the dragon-snake game before they sleep soundly .

title: Unit 3: TEENAGERS
content: During the stressful midterm period, many teenagers struggle to concentrate on their schoolwork because of high parental expectation and intense peer pressure . Therefore , to reduce stress , they often log on to a user-friendly website or a social media forum to connect and get on with other talkative friends. Some are curious to browse the internet for a new craft or prepare beforehand for a full-day gaming tournament , making their free time more enjoyable . They might upload pictures to their personal account to show off their achievements and wait for every new notification during a late-night online session . However, teenagers must be mature and stay focused , otherwise , they might become victims of online bullying or face a cyber bully .

title: Unit 4: ETHNIC GROUPS OF VIETNAM
content: Vietnam has many a diverse ethnic group and minority living in both the highland and lowland areas, with the Kinh being the dominant one. In the mountains, people often live in a traditional wooden stilt house built on a sturdy post that can overlook a beautiful terraced field. A prominent feature of their villages is the large communal house where locals gather to play the gong , blow the flute or bamboo flute , and sing folk songs around an open fire . Many villagers weave colorful, traditional costume s and prepare delicious five-colour sticky rice to enrich their cultural festivals. They raise livestock under their homes and use a waterwheel to irrigate the rich soil for their crop , especially during the busy harvest season. Some families also manage a rubber tree plantation , while others use ash to fertilize their fields and carve a beautiful statue to place near the multi-storey staircase of their homes.

title: Unit 5: OUR CUSTOMS AND TRADITIONS
content: In Vietnam, every unique custom promotes strong family bonding and a joyous family reunion , especially during important holidays. Before Tet, families worship the Kitchen Gods by preparing an offering and they release a live carp into the riverside to bring good luck. They decorate their homes with a kumquat or other ornamental tree , and set up a decorative bamboo pole to chase away any bad spirit . During the New Year, people visit pagodas to admire the architecture, pray for longevity , and listen to a wise monk , while maintaining good table manners at home feasts. At Mid-Autumn, children light up a beautiful lantern to celebrate the Moon Goddess , enjoying sweet treats and young rice under the moonlight. Meanwhile, in coastal villages, a lively festival goer might watch a thrilling lion dance or a grand ceremony . The festivals also feature exciting competitions where a skilled contestant performs amazing acrobatics or traditional martial arts .

title: Unit 6: LIFESTYLE
content: While people in the modern world are often in a hurry and in the habit of choosing online learning or buying quick street food from a roadside stall, others try to maintain a more traditional lifestyle . For an unforgettable experience , a nomadic musher might travel by dogsled through the snow to build an igloo . They often feel sore from mushing all day, yet they love being completely independent . In a different setting, a skilled tribal artisan will practice to make craft items and revive an ancient handicraft , creating a decorative piece that holds an important cultural title . At mealtime , whether a well-paid waiter or waitress will serve a local speciality or home-grown vegetables, a warm greeting is always how people greet each other. Finally, the impact of technology has heavily changed human interaction , forcing us to choose how we interact both online and offline .

title: Unit 7: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
content: Every local resident should participate in the environmental movement to protect our fragile ecosystem . We must reduce our carbon footprint because burning a simple campfire or driving cars can release too much carbon dioxide and other toxic substance s. Trees are vital because they absorb bad gases, give us fresh oxygen , and even provide medicinal value. In the oceans, beautiful coral reefs and the rare dugong are losing their natural habitat due to terrible plastic rubbish and single-use product s. If we do not act quickly, many endangered species will face complete extinction . We must protect every vulnerable species from human harm and natural disasters like a fierce tornado , which often appears as a conical storm in the sky. By working together, we can save the Earth for future generations.

title: Unit 8: SHOPPING
content: A true shopaholic who is addicted to buying new things will often look at every item on display whenever an attractive advertisement announces that products are on sale . To access the best prices, a smart customer might take a quick shuttle to a discount shop , a dollar store , or a 24-hour convenience store where the price tag is usually fixed . On the other hand, a small minority of shoppers prefer to take their time and browse the unique goods at a traditional open-air market or a lively village fair that opens year-round . At this bustling market , they can bargain for a lovely yellowish bouquet from a local florist . Moreover, they can easily find healthy home-grown vegetables and delicious home-made foods. If anyone ever has a complaint about a purchase, the friendly vendors are always ready to solve the issue.

title: Unit 9: NATURAL DISASTERS
content: A natural disaster like a tropical storm or a tornado with a dark funnel can suddenly pull up trees and destroy a pretty town. When the authority decides to broadcast and warn citizens about an incoming tsunami , an earthquake measuring high on the Richter scale , or a violent storm , everyone must be cautious and find a safe shelter . In mountainous areas, heavy rain coming with lighting can cause a dangerous landslide or mass movement where rocks come down and sweep away everything, making the roads very unsafe . Meanwhile, a volcanic eruption can cause a mountain to shake and tremble violently before it begins to erupt hot liquid and poisonous gas. Because scientists cannot always predict these events, every family should prepare an emergency kit to protect their property and lives from severe damage . After the event, brave rescue worker s often face extreme temperatures in Fahrenheit to help every victim and start the long clean-up process of the volcanic ash or flood water.

title: Unit 10: COMMUNICATION IN THE FUTURE
content: Long ago, people used a slow carrier pigeon to send messages, but in the future, communicating will be a piece of cake thanks to highly advanced technology . With a stable Internet connection and a high-speed network, your smartphone , smartwatch , or tablet can instantly transmit a text , a voice message , or a cute smiley emoji to any social network account . If you do not want to meet in person , you can easily adjust your webcam for a live video conference , ensuring the meeting runs smoothly even for an absentee . During an introductory call, you might need to say " hold on " to filter out unwanted noise or remember to charge your device automatically . To overcome any language barrier , a built-in translation machine will help you understand everyone without any effort . Finally, beyond holography , scientists believe that future humans might even use telepathy to share a thought directly from mind to mind .

title: Unit 11: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
content: The rapid development of science and technology has helped us discover a powerful cure like radium and invent a new solution or application to fight a dangerous epidemic . In education, instead of checking manual attendance , schools now use a biometric scanner with fingerprint , facial , and voice recognition to mark students present, significantly reducing truancy . On a digital platform , teachers can develop a breakout room to give direct feedback just like a face to face class. However, at times , students might send a private message or swap answers on the screen , which unfortunately leads to cheating . To stop this, a brilliant invention using eye-tracking inside a smart contact lens makes monitoring completely effortless . Furthermore, people rarely complain about services nowadays because we even have a robot bartender performing every complex experiment perfectly.

title: Unit 12: LIFE ON OTHER PLANETS
content: Looking through a powerful telescope at our solar system in the milky way galaxy , scientists explore the possibility of finding a habitable planet . They study what elements planets like Mars or Venus are made up of . In outer space , the brave commander of a high-speed spaceship must obey strict rules . This ensures the rocket does not break down during a thrilling mission to distant planets like Jupiter , Saturn , Uranus , and Neptune . Meanwhile, Mercury has a rocky surface with many a deep crater and weak gravity , experiencing extreme temperatures during the daytime . Some people oppose the idea that a strange alien or a mysterious creature could take over our world, even if a stormy UFO is spotted in the sky all year round . However, finding even a tiny trace of water is a promising sign that life might exist beyond Earth .

title: Unit 1: LEISURE TIME (Band 6.5)
content: During my leisure time, I prefer to hang out with friends outdoors to play badminton because it helps me stay in shape and build muscle balance . However, my sister is crazy about indoor activities; she is keen on knitting and making a DIY dollhouse using a special kit . Some people might think it is cruel to keep pets indoors all day, nevertheless , my cat loves to sit beside me and watch me fold origami , especially when I make a beautiful paper flower . I absolutely detest winter sports like skiing and snowboarding at a mountain resort , but I am very fond of making a home-made bracelet or solving a difficult puzzle . Whenever I want to relax, I fancy watching a funny comedy , reading a comic book, or simply surfing the net to send a message to keep in touch with my cousins. Everyone has different hobbies, but whether you are into something active or just quiet crafts, the most important thing is to enjoy what you do!

title: Unit 2: LIFE IN THE COUNTRYSIDE (Band 6.5)
content: My grandparents live in a picturesque ancient cottage situated by a vast stretch of green paddy field and a small canal where local children often catch fish. The hard-working farmers cultivate the crop , wait for the grain to dry , and use a well-trained water buffalo to plough the soil. Nowadays, they also use a modern combine harvester to speed up their work during the busy harvest season. Early every morning, I observe the villagers as they feed the poultry near the pond , milk the dairy cattle , and herd the sheep. Later, they load baskets of fresh fruit from the orchard onto a truck and unload them at the local market to sell their regional speciality . The scenery is truly fascinating , and the people are generous , supportive , and hospitable , never acting unsociable to tourists who take a ferry to visit the nearby lighthouse . In the afternoon, children with a sun-kissed tan enjoy kite-flying , playing the dragon-snake game , or participating in traditional bamboo dancing , which makes city dwellers envy their joyful lifestyle before everyone sleeps soundly at night.

title: Unit 3: TEENAGERS (Band 6.5)
content: Teenagers today often face immense expectation and peer pressure to perform well in their schoolwork , especially during a stressful midterm session . Therefore , they must concentrate and stay focused on their studies, otherwise , the academic burden can become overwhelming. To manage this stress , many find it enjoyable to take a break after a full-day of classes to connect with friends or try a relaxing craft . Being naturally curious and highly talkative , they frequently log on to a user-friendly website or social media to browse for information, check every new notification , and get on with their classmates. Some teens use their online account to upload photos and show off their achievements in a local gaming tournament , while others prefer to join a discussion forum to prepare for events beforehand . Unfortunately, the digital world also exposes them to cyber bullying , where a cruel bully might target someone, forcing youths to become more mature in handling such negative experiences.

title: Unit 4: ETHNIC GROUPS OF VIETNAM (Band 6.5)
content: Vietnam is home to a diverse population, where each minority ethnic group in the highland and the dominant group in the lowland help to enrich the country's cultural heritage . In many mountainous villages, a striking feature is the traditional wooden stilt house , which is built on a sturdy post with a steep staircase and designed to overlook the breathtaking terraced fields . Some wealthier families even build a multi-storey home next to a stream where a large waterwheel spins continuously. To ensure a bountiful harvest , the farmers mix burnt ash into the soil to grow their main crop , alongside managing a vast rubber tree plantation and continuing to raise livestock . During festivals, people gather at the communal house around an open fire to enjoy delicious five-colour sticky rice and worship their ancestors before a beautifully carved statue . Their vibrant traditions are also expressed when women weave intricate patterns for their traditional costume , and men play a bamboo flute or a simple flute and strike a gong to the rhythm of lively folk dances .

title: Unit 5: OUR CUSTOMS AND TRADITIONS (Band 6.5)
content: In Vietnam, every meaningful custom provides a wonderful opportunity for family reunion and family bonding . Before the Lunar New Year, people make an offering and release a live carp at the riverside to bid farewell to the Kitchen Gods . Furthermore, families decorate their houses with a decorative kumquat or other ornamental tree to chase away any bad spirit . During the New Year ceremony , a wise monk will often pray for the longevity of the elders, and parents remind children of proper table manners before the grand feast. Later in the year, children admire the bright lantern lighting up the streets as they worship the Moon Goddess and enjoy sweet cakes made from young rice . Meanwhile, in a coastal village, local events attract many a festival goer who gathers to watch a spectacular lion dance alongside thrilling acrobatics and impressive martial arts . During these traditional games, skilled contestant s even perform and balance on top of a tall bamboo pole !

title: Unit 6: LIFESTYLE (Band 6.5)
content: In today's fast-paced world, many people are in a hurry and in the habit of grabbing street food from a roadside stall rather than enjoying a proper family mealtime . However, some individuals try to maintain an independent lifestyle by cooking with home-grown ingredients. The impact of modern technology is undeniable, as people often choose a well-paid online job and interact through online learning instead of having face-to-face offline interaction . In stark contrast, people with a nomadic or tribal background in freezing climates might sleep in a traditional igloo and travel by dogsled . In these snowy regions, a skilled musher leads the dogs in the practice of mushing for miles, even when their feet feel sore . Meanwhile, to revive local traditions, a dedicated artisan will often make craft products, creating a beautiful handicraft or a decorative item that becomes a famous regional speciality and earns them a respected title . Whenever tourists visit to witness these unique cultures, a friendly waiter or waitress will always greet them with a warm greeting and serve them delicious local food, providing a truly unforgettable experience .

title: Unit 7: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (Band 6.5)
content: Environmental protection is a crucial movement that encourages every resident to participate in efforts to reduce our carbon footprint and protect the planet's fragile ecosystem . Unfortunately, modern human activities often release a lot of toxic substance s and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, while cutting down the forests that normally absorb these harmful gases and provide us with clean oxygen . This pollution, along with extreme weather events like a destructive tornado , severely damages the natural habitat of many animals, pushing an endangered species closer to complete extinction . In the ocean, marine species such as the gentle dugong and beautiful coral reefs suffer greatly when careless people dump plastic rubbish and single-use product s into the water. On land, leaving a campfire unattended can cause massive forest fires, destroying both wildlife and valuable medicinal plants. Even discarding a traditional conical hat made of natural leaves is much safer for the environment than throwing away non-biodegradable trash, so we must act now to save our Earth.

title: Unit 8: SHOPPING (Band 6.5)
content: Being a true shopaholic who is absolutely addicted to buying new goods , I often take a free shuttle bus to the city center to access a huge year-round market . I also enjoy visiting a vibrant open-air market to browse through the beautiful flowers at a local florist . Sometimes, an attractive advertisement on display outside a 24-hour convenience store catches my eye, but I prefer places where I can find a great bargain . Therefore, I frequently visit a cheap dollar store or a discount shop where almost every item has a fixed price tag and is often on sale . Yesterday, I went to a community fair organized by a local minority group. There, I bought fresh home-grown vegetables and tasted a special yellowish home-made cake. As a happy customer , I have never needed to file a complaint , because my shopping trips are always full of joy and good deals!

title: Unit 9: NATURAL DISASTERS (Band 6.5)
content: It is hard to predict when a devastating disaster like a tropical storm or a tornado with its dark funnel will suddenly strike and destroy a pretty coastal town, causing massive damage to private property . Meanwhile, in mountainous regions, heavy rains can cause a dangerous mass movement of earth known as a landslide , which can sweep away everything in its path and leave buildings completely unsafe . If an earthquake happens, you might feel the ground tremble and shake violently , sometimes registering high on the Richter scale , which prompts the local authority to broadcast a message to warn citizens to stay cautious and find immediate shelter . In other areas, a volcanic eruption can cause a volcano to erupt , shooting burning liquid rock and poisonous gas high into the sky, while intense heat measured in degrees Fahrenheit makes the surrounding volcanic environment extremely hostile. Furthermore, a severe sea storm can trigger a massive tsunami that crashes onto the shore, or intense lighting from the sky can strike before heavy rains come down . After the event, a dedicated rescue worker must often pull up debris to find a trapped victim , while volunteers begin the massive clean-up process while carrying an emergency kit for safety.

title: Unit 10: COMMUNICATION IN THE FUTURE (Band 6.5)
content: In the future, relying on a slow carrier pigeon or traveling long distances to meet in person will be fully replaced by advanced technologies. For instance, telepathy might be used to transmit a thought instantly without the need for any physical device. Even today, it is a piece of cake to use a smartphone , a tablet , or a smartwatch with a high-speed Internet connection . With these tools, we can easily send a text , a voice message , or a smiley emoji on a social network through our personal account . If you are out or wish to avoid unwanted calls, your devices will automatically adjust their settings, politely asking the caller to " hold on " and ensuring everything runs smoothly . Furthermore, if you face a language barrier , an introductory translation machine will translate the conversation live during a video conference , provided you remember to charge your high-tech webcam . Finally, schools will even be able to monitor an absentee using stunning holography , creating virtual classrooms that bring everyone together seamlessly.

title: Unit 11: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (Band 6.5)
content: The rapid advancement of science and technology has helped scientists develop new ways to discover a cure for any widespread epidemic , much like how the historical invention of radium changed medicine. In education, a modern digital platform allows students to learn without meeting face to face , using a specific application to join a breakout room or send a private message to their teacher. To solve issues like truancy and tracking attendance , schools now use a biometric scanner that requires a fingerprint or facial recognition rather than relying on a manual mark . Furthermore, to prevent cheating during online exams, teachers use eye-tracking software through the computer screen or even a smart contact lens , giving immediate feedback on student behavior. At times , people might complain about losing jobs to automation, but artificial intelligence makes daily life almost effortless ; for example, a robot bartender with voice recognition can easily swap ingredients to mix drinks perfectly. Ultimately, through continuous experiment , researchers continue to invent a better solution for our future, proving that innovation never truly stops.

title: Unit 12: LIFE ON OTHER PLANETS (Band 6.5)
content: Looking through a powerful telescope at the majestic milky way galaxy , scientists constantly search our solar system and outer space for a habitable planet where humans could survive all year round . While Mercury and Venus are dangerously hot during the daytime , and gas giants like Jupiter , Saturn , Uranus , and Neptune have a highly stormy atmosphere, Mars remains a promising candidate . Despite its weak gravity and a rocky surface marked by many a deep crater , researchers are excited about the possibility of finding a trace of a microscopic creature there . Last month, a brave commander led a thrilling expedition into the unknown, boarding a high-tech spaceship propelled by a massive rocket that is made up of advanced materials so it will never break down mid-flight . During their journey, they investigated strange signals, wondering if they would encounter a mysterious UFO or an intelligent alien species . Should an extraterrestrial force ever attempt to take over our world, humanity must stand united to oppose the threat, rather than choose to silently obey .

title: Unit 1: LEISURE TIME (Band 7.5)
content: In today's fast-paced world, individuals fancy diverse leisure activities to strike a healthy balance in life, whether they prefer the outdoors or staying inside . While some are crazy about extreme winter sports like skiing and snowboarding at a mountain resort to build muscle and stay in shape , others detest such physically demanding pursuits, finding them almost cruel to their bodies . Nevertheless , many teenagers are profoundly fond of relaxing activities; they might hang out with peers, read a comic , watch a comedy , or spend hours surfing the net to send a message and keep in touch with friends . Conversely, creative souls who are into hands-on hobbies are often keen on utilizing a DIY kit to craft a delicate bracelet or assemble an intricate dollhouse . Others might patiently fold paper to master the art of origami , construct a beautiful paper flower , engage in knitting home-made garments, or solve a challenging mental puzzle . Even for those who usually play a competitive game of badminton , embracing these varied hobbies ensures a well-rounded and fulfilling lifestyle.

title: Unit 2: LIFE IN THE COUNTRYSIDE (Band 7.5)
content: City dwellers often envy how locals neatly situate their ancient cottage near a tranquil canal to enjoy the picturesque scenery and the vast stretch of a golden paddy field . Hard-working farmers, who are never unsociable but rather generous , supportive , and incredibly hospitable , tirelessly cultivate the land, plough the soil, and dry the freshly harvested grain . During the harvest season, they systematically load and unload their bountiful crop onto a heavy truck , often relying on a highly efficient combine harvester rather than traditional manual labor. Visitors who take a ferry across the river can observe laborers working under the sun until they develop a deep tan , or watch them patiently feed the poultry and manually milk the cattle . It is absolutely fascinating to see a shepherd expertly herd sheep with the help of well-trained dogs near a blossoming orchard , while others try to catch fresh fish from a peaceful pond . As evening approaches, people might enjoy a regional culinary speciality , gaze towards a distant coastal lighthouse , or watch children playfully participate in bamboo dancing , kite-flying , and the traditional dragon-snake game before returning home to sleep soundly .

title: Unit 3: TEENAGERS (Band 7.5)
content: Modern teenagers often face immense expectation from their families and peer pressure at school, which can make their daily lives incredibly stressful and full of psychological stress . Therefore , to cope with the rigorous demands of their schoolwork and midterm exams, many students try to remain highly focused and concentrate during every study session ; otherwise , they might fall significantly behind. In their free time, adolescents naturally seek enjoyable activities to unwind; while some talkative and curious youths prefer to connect with friends outdoors or engage in a hands-on craft , others retreat to the digital world. It is increasingly common for a mature teen to log on to a user-friendly website or social media platform, create a personal account , and browse an online forum to stay updated with every notification . However, they must be vigilant online, as some individuals use these platforms to upload inappropriate content, show off their achievements in a gaming tournament , or even cyber- bully others, leading to severe emotional impacts stemming from such bullying . To maintain a healthy lifestyle, teenagers should strategically plan their full-day schedules beforehand to ensure they get on with their classmates harmoniously and balance their academic duties with personal growth.

title: Unit 4: ETHNIC GROUPS OF VIETNAM (Band 7.5)
content: Vietnam is a culturally diverse nation where the dominant ethnic group coexists peacefully with a rich tapestry of minority communities spread across both the lowland regions and the remote highland . In many indigenous villages, the central architectural feature is the magnificent communal house , often a towering, multi-storey stilt house resting on sturdy wooden post s that proudly overlook the surrounding valleys. To access these elevated living spaces, one must climb a meticulously carved staircase , frequently adorned with a protective traditional statue at the base. Inside their homes, families often gather around a crackling open fire to cook their staple meals, using traditional methods to prepare five-colour sticky rice while disposing of the remaining ash to naturally enrich the fertile soil . The agricultural lifestyle is deeply ingrained here; locals expertly manage terraced fields to cultivate an abundant crop leading up to the autumn harvest , whilst others manage a sprawling rubber tree plantation or utilize a bamboo waterwheel for irrigation. Furthermore, communities sustainably raise various types of livestock for sustenance and skillfully weave intricate patterns to create the vibrant traditional costume worn during festive occasions. During communal celebrations, the air resonates with the enchanting melodies of a bamboo flute or a simple flute , the rhythmic beating of a bronze gong , and captivating folk tales that celebrate their enduring heritage.

title: Unit 5: OUR CUSTOMS AND TRADITIONS (Band 7.5)
content: In Vietnam, deeply rooted custom s play a pivotal role in fostering family bonding during a joyous family reunion , where younger generations are meticulously taught impeccable table manners . Prior to the Lunar New Year, households bid farewell to the Kitchen Gods by purchasing a live carp to gently release into a nearby lake, before embellishing their homes with a vibrant kumquat or another auspicious ornamental tree . On the first day of the year, many devotees visit pagodas to interact with a venerable monk , engaging in devout worship and presenting a meticulous offering as they earnestly pray for health and longevity . Later in the year, the Mid-Autumn Festival pays homage to the Moon Goddess , illuminating the night sky with every brightly lit lantern while people savor delicate pastries crafted from fragrant young rice . Every enthusiastic festival goer gathers to admire the spectacular displays of martial arts and breathtaking acrobatics during the rhythmic lion dance , which is traditionally believed to chase away any lingering bad spirit alongside a ceremoniously erected bamboo pole . Meanwhile, in both coastal regions and bustling riverside communities, a fiercely competitive contestant might partake in a grand maritime ceremony , surrounded by highly decorative boats that celebrate the nation's rich aquatic heritage.

title: Unit 6: LIFESTYLE (Band 7.5)
content: In an increasingly interconnected world where many are in the habit of living predominantly online through virtual interaction and online learning , some individuals consciously choose to maintain a fiercely independent lifestyle completely offline . For instance, a skilled musher might lead a traditional nomadic or tribal existence in the freezing Arctic, relying on a sturdy dogsled for transportation while enduring sore muscles from rigorous mushing to ultimately build a temporary igloo . These isolated communities strive to revive ancestral customs and deeply value an authentic, human experience when they warmly greet visitors with a traditional greeting , ensuring a profound impact on anyone they interact with. Conversely, in bustling urban areas, people who are constantly in a hurry might simply grab a quick bite of home-grown produce or local street food from a roadside vendor, often sacrificing the communal joy of a proper family mealtime . Meanwhile, a dedicated artisan might hold the honorary title of master craftsman as they rigorously practice their skills to make craft items, producing a highly decorative handicraft that embodies their rich cultural heritage. In the modern hospitality sector, a well-paid waitress or a polite waiter will expertly serve a regional culinary speciality to discerning customers, seamlessly blending old-world warmth with contemporary dining trends.

title: Unit 7: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (Band 7.5)
content: It is imperative that every local resident actively participate in the global movement to protect our fragile ecosystem from the devastating impacts of unchecked human activity. The ubiquitous reliance on every single-use product has led to oceans overflowing with plastic rubbish , which inevitably introduces many a toxic substance into marine food webs. Consequently, the continuous degradation of a pristine marine habitat , particularly vibrant coral reefs, pushes many a vulnerable species —such as the gentle sea cow known as the dugong —closer to the brink of absolute extinction , definitively classifying them as an endangered species . On land, instead of allowing vast forests to naturally absorb harmful emissions and generate life-sustaining oxygen , human actions incessantly release detrimental carbon dioxide , drastically increasing our collective carbon footprint . Such careless anthropogenic actions can range from massive industrial deforestation down to human negligence like an unextinguished campfire left ablaze in the wilderness. This rapid climate shift not only intensifies severe meteorological phenomena like a catastrophic tornado , but also threatens the survival of rare medicinal plants growing along conical hillsides that indigenous communities have historically relied upon.

title: Unit 8: SHOPPING (Band 7.5)
content: In today's consumer-driven society, an alarming number of individuals have become thoroughly addicted to retail therapy, embodying the classic shopaholic who endlessly loves to browse through the bustling aisles of a metropolitan market or a seasonal trade fair . To captivate a potential customer , retailers heavily invest in a persuasive advertisement campaign and construct an alluring display for every premium item that is currently on sale . Frugal consumers meticulously searching for a lucrative bargain may board a complimentary shuttle heading toward a massive discount shop or a budget-friendly dollar store . In these establishments, shoppers can acquire mass-produced goods bearing an incredibly low price tag , strictly avoiding the rigid, fixed pricing models of high-end boutiques. Conversely, for unparalleled nocturnal access , urbanites frequently rely on a year-round convenience store , even though an occasional complaint arises regarding the nutritional value of their offerings. Meanwhile, a distinct minority of culturally appreciative buyers gravitate towards an authentic open-air market , where they can support a local florist or purchase a home-grown vegetable and a delicate, home-made artifact that proudly bears a slightly aged, yellowish patina.

title: Unit 9: NATURAL DISASTERS (Band 7.5)
content: When an unpredictable disaster like a massive earthquake begins to violently shake the ground, making buildings tremble , the local authority will immediately broadcast an alert to warn citizens about the unsafe conditions . Meteorologists might predict that a fierce storm , a severe tropical storm , or a swirling tornado , characterized by a terrifying funnel , will suddenly come down to destroy vast amounts of public property and damage infrastructure, possessing enough force to pull up massive trees by their roots . In mountainous regions, heavy precipitation can trigger a devastating mass movement or landslide that might easily sweep away homes, while coastal areas constantly fear a towering tsunami . Furthermore, when a dormant mountain begins to erupt during a spectacular volcanic eruption , it rapidly releases a glowing, poisonous liquid magma that can reach temperatures of thousands of degrees Fahrenheit alongside hazardous volcanic ash and intense sky lighting . Therefore, residents must be exceedingly cautious , meticulously prepare a comprehensive emergency kit , and seek a secure shelter to avoid becoming a tragic victim of these pretty severe natural forces . After the catastrophic event subsides, a dedicated rescue worker will assess the seismic activity on the Richter scale , while the community organizes a massive clean-up effort to restore the affected areas .

title: Unit 10: COMMUNICATION IN THE FUTURE (Band 7.5)
content: The evolution of human interaction has drastically shifted from relying on an archaic carrier pigeon to utilizing an advanced smartphone , a versatile tablet , or a wearable smartwatch powered by a high-speed Internet connection . Consequently, creating an account on a ubiquitous social network to rapidly transmit a digitized text , send an emotive emoji or a classic smiley , and record a quick voice message has become a piece of cake . Furthermore, users can effortlessly filter out any unwanted disruptions, ask callers to briefly hold on , and rely on their devices to automatically adjust acoustic settings to ensure discussions proceed smoothly . In the corporate sphere, to accommodate an absentee who is unable to attend a crucial briefing in person , organizations frequently orchestrate a live video conference utilizing a high-definition webcam . During such global interactions, professionals effortlessly bypass the language barrier since an integrated translation machine can instantly interpret dialogues right after an introductory remark. Looking towards the distant future, immersive technologies like holography will project three-dimensional avatars at no exorbitant charge , while theoretical frameworks like telepathy might eventually allow a solitary thought to be communicated directly between minds.

title: Unit 11: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (Band 7.5)
content: The rapid evolution of modern science and technology has led developers to continually develop a sophisticated digital platform that can, at times , replace traditional face to face interaction. In educational institutions, advanced biometric systems utilizing a fingerprint scanner , alongside facial recognition and voice recognition , are implemented to strictly monitor attendance , thereby preventing truancy and academic cheating . During online seminars, participants can collaborate in a virtual breakout room while gazing at an interactive screen , whereas some use a smart contact lens with eye-tracking capabilities to make navigation completely effortless . Although educators might complain about the tedious manual grading process to calculate a final mark , automated systems now provide instant feedback and allow users to swap ideas via a secure private message . Beyond classrooms, the application of AI offers an innovative solution for the hospitality industry, prompting engineers to invent a robotic bartender , a remarkable invention that precisely mixes beverages. Historically, rigorous scientific experiment s enabled researchers to discover groundbreaking elements like radium , paving the way for medical advancements that could potentially cure a deadly epidemic .

title: Unit 12: LIFE ON OTHER PLANETS (Band 7.5)
content: Peering through a powerful telescope into the vastness of outer space , astronomers passionately study our solar system , which is entirely made up of fascinating celestial bodies within the milky way galaxy . While Mercury and Venus experience scorching temperatures during the daytime , and gas giants like Jupiter , Saturn , Uranus , and Neptune boast extremely stormy atmospheres all year round , Mars currently remains the most promising candidate for future human colonization. Researchers eagerly search for a microscopic trace of water hidden within a deep Martian crater on its barren surface , clinging to the distinct possibility that the red planet was once a fully habitable world. The thrilling prospect of discovering a highly intelligent alien or even a microscopic extraterrestrial creature has fueled decades of intensive research, despite skeptics who vehemently oppose the existence of any mysterious UFO . To investigate further, a courageous commander must pilot a highly advanced spaceship launched by a powerful rocket to escape Earth's gravity , demanding that the entire crew strictly obey all mission protocols. Ultimately, if critical life-support mechanisms were to break down during the perilous interstellar voyage, automated artificial intelligence systems would instantly take over to ensure the survival of the pioneers.
